behavior.public_seal: Requires an installed DAG lifecycle registry before the first RPC or server mutation.
behavior.reason: The registry owns immutable operation intent, unknown-ACK recovery and unused-preview cleanup. A successful public seal without it could strand metadata.

ownership_exception.allowed_change: Install the bounded DAG registry context in existing synthetic facade fixtures; preserve their metadata, replay, conflict, no-execution and source-drift assertions.

scope: Implementation refinement of the frozen Flow-scope cleanup contract; no public route, DTO, lifecycle state or acceptance-criteria change.
